_comment: Copy to config.local.json (gitignored), replace every <placeholder>, then run: python -c 'from plaud_workflow.config import initialize; print(initialize())'. That writes runtime/config.json, which the service reads. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_asr_backend: Optional. Set "asr_backend": "qwen3" plus the three qwen_* keys below to use the MLX Qwen3 ASR + forced aligner instead of Whisper.
_speaker_attribution: "current" keeps the sherpa-onnx speaker turns. "new_mix" enables the Nemotron attribute stage; it needs the nemotron block, which `python -m plaud_workflow.attribution manifest --config-merge` writes after `runtime-deploy`.
